svg.title: LLM labels as research measurements
svg.desc: Interview excerpts go to an LLM, while a selected evaluation sample is reviewed by people using the same rubric. Saved LLM labels become research variables. Comparing labels on the same evaluation cases reveals a missed need and a false positive. The research analysis must account for these errors and their uncertainty when estimating prevalence or group differences. The case labels and interval glyph illustrate the process, not measured results.
svg.text: Check the labels and their effect on the research estimates
